courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 鋼板樁圍堰支撐
related.transfer: 可遷移「接觸間隙的機理與驗證」與「第二階偏心的機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；鋼板樁圍堰支撐的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Contact gap mechanism and verification" and "Second-order eccentricity mechanism and verification" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦內支撐預壓、溫度軸力與分階段卸載；鋼板樁圍堰支撐則以圍堰水壓、圍檁支撐與基底滲流穩定為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on strut preload, thermal axial force and staged unloading; Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing centres on cofferdam water pressure, walers, struts and base seepage, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「接觸間隙」與「靜水壓合力」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到鋼板樁圍堰支撐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「抽水荷載增量的機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Contact gap” and “Hydrostatic resultant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sheet-pile cofferdam bracing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Dewatering load increment mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 深開挖內支撐預壓
history.text: 深開挖內支撐預壓用來消除間隙並限制壁體位移，卻也會引入額外構件力與地層反力。本課將預壓目標、軸向剛度、溫度作用、座板接觸及鎖定損失分開討論，再用多支撐互制、第二階效應與卸載變位建立設計及現場量測的共同基準。公開資料沿革以指南出版及資料覆核為準，不冒充個別工程施工史。1999年：美國聯邦公路管理局發布地錨及錨定系統指南，包含試驗與防蝕背景；2017年：香港地盤勘察指南二提供二〇一七年更新版本，作為調查證據背景；2020年：香港擋土牆設計指南提供二〇二〇年版本，其適用範圍不全面涵蓋深開挖。比較案例僅說明工程用途與界面差異，未核對的工法不作實績聲稱。本課重建公開原理及原創教學算例，不代表任何專案設計文件。
history.textEn: Preloading excavation struts closes gaps and limits wall movement while introducing additional member forces and ground reactions. The course separates preload targets, axial stiffness, temperature, seating and lock-off loss, then links strut interaction, second-order effects and unloading movement to common design and measurement baselines. The source chronology records guide publication and evidence review rather than inventing a project construction history. 1999: FHWA publishes the ground-anchor guide including testing and corrosion-protection context; 2017: CEDD provides the 2017 updated Geoguide 2 as an investigation reference; 2020: CEDD provides the 2020 retaining-wall guide, whose scope does not comprehensively cover deep excavation. Named comparisons illustrate functions and interfaces without attributing unverified methods. This course reconstructs public principles with original educational calculations, not the design documents of any project.
